messages:
Carmen: Quick kickoff — we're scheduling the search-ranking-v2 rollout next week. Proposal: ops lanes + SLO budget, short canaries, explicit rollback scripts. Need :eyes: from SRE and customer-ops.
Liam: +1. Feature flag will be ff/search_rank_v2. Canary pattern: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows.
Nora: Gate metrics to check: p50 latency, p95 latency, backend error-rate, and a lightweight quality regression on the eval prompt set (automated smoke eval). If any gate trips, auto-shed to previous variant.
Sam: Draft runbook snippet below for rollback and kill-switch:
```
# rollback to previous model instance
redwoodctl deployment rollback --service search --to-tag previous --force
# temporary kill switch (feature flag off)
redwoodctl flags disable ff/search_rank_v2 --global
```
Carmen: Question for SRE: what's our SLO burn budget for a canary window before we require manual intervention? I propose 0.25% of monthly error budget reserved per canary slice.
Liam: That seems reasonable. For latency-sensitive queries (hotpath) reduce canary window to 15m and only 5% -> 25% if hotpath error budget < 10%.
Nora: Telemetry hooks we need wired: per-flag traffic split, per-model p95, expensive-op traces, and a shadow logging sample (1%) for quality inspection. Also ensure alert/incident policy maps to the feature flag owner.
Sam: Ops-lane owners: Carmen (PM) for customer comms, Liam (Eng) for rollout orchestration, Nora (SRE) for metric gates and alerts, Sam for rollback ops. I'll add a quick Slack automation for the canary windows.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created: search-ranking-v2 | 2026-06-03T18:00:00Z | windows: [5% x30m, 25% x30m] | flag: ff/search_rank_v2. Auto-fallback enabled.
Carmen: Customer-readiness checklist: notify 2 enterprise customers 72h prior; add canary-specific telemetry dashboard; ensure on-call rotation flagged; prepare release notes snippet.
Liam: I'll commit the canary config to ops repo and include the exact rollout YAML. Quick sample:
```yaml
rollout:
  flag: ff/search_rank_v2
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 25
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 100
      duration: 1h
gates:
  - type: error_rate
    threshold: 0.5%
  - type: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 400
  - type: quality_regression_pct
    threshold: 0.5
```
Nora: One more: add a soft-fail path where we reduce to a cheaper model-quantized variant automatically if latency spikes but quality holds. Otherwise full rollback.
Carmen: Sounds good. Action items: Liam will open rollout PR with YAML + flag; Nora will add dashboard panels and alerts; Sam will publish runbook and rollback snippet; Carmen will draft customer note. Sign-offs by EOD Friday?
Liam: On it.
Nora: Will own alerts.
Sam: Runbook published when PR merges.
Carmen: Thanks team — tagging @here once PR is live and scheduling a 15m ops sync before canary.
